finding_text: Random platelet pools with positive bottle alarms are not always managed within a timely manner and accord ing to the appropriate standard operating procedur es.

finding_text: Quality Assurance oversight ofcontrol processes is insufficient: • Cerezyme release specifications for drug substance and drug product do not reflect manufacturing history and process capability.

finding_text: Process deviations were not recorded in a separate file or log that details both the deviation and the actions taken.

finding_text: Employees are not given training in the particular operations they perform as part of their function.

finding_text: Media fills were not performed that closely simulate aseptic production operations incorporating, as appropriate, worst-case activities and conditions that provide a challenge to aseptic operations.
